Frequently asked questions

How many healthcare jobs are listed?

Fortune Jobs AI lists 1,040 open healthcare jobs in the United States as of November 25, 2026.

Which roles are covered?

This catalogue includes Registered Nurse (1,040).

Which states have the most listings?

The leading states in this snapshot are Pennsylvania (197), New Jersey (138), North Carolina (105), Massachusetts (45), and Missouri (43).

Why do some counts have no state-page link?

Links point to existing indexed role/state pages. Healthcare and transport role/state pages require at least 5 open jobs; other counts still contribute to the category total.

What should I check before applying?

Use the original posting to confirm availability, requirements, pay and application instructions. Fortune Jobs AI is a job portal and does not guarantee a response or hiring outcome.
